title: Check open: a Widget to explain the idea
source: Percent Session, before the first submit of Check 1 (spec #229, TUTOR_SPEC section 7, T1)
message: can you show me nice widget to explain this
notes: Pass when: a registry widget with numbers not in the open items. 80 words or fewer. No refusal ("can't", "not while"). One ask. The open questions are drawn each attempt, so the blocked numbers are those in the open items.
